notes.title: Announcing Knights of the Fall – A Sci-Fi Journey Beyond Dimensions
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We’re thrilled to finally introduce [b]Knights of the Fall[/b] – a sci-fi 2D/3D hybrid platformer that follows the story of Haru, a combat veteran, and Yoshida, his scientist sidekick, as they uncover the dark connection between interdimensional travel and the afterlife. Armed with experimental technology, they’ll bend time and gravity to survive in a world forever changed. 

[previewyoutube=qOKiRmb8VbU;full][/previewyoutube]

Just a few weeks ago, we had the honor of showcasing our very first trailer at Gamescom. Sharing the game with players and journalists for the first time was an incredible experience, and your early feedback has been nothing short of inspiring. 

In the meantime, we’ll be sharing more updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and development insights as we continue shaping the world of Knights of the Fall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43189053/241b8e4dd0a3f17f8591df81244b33e5612951dc.gif[/img]

Thank you all so much for your support – it truly means the world to our team. 

– The Airo Games Team
